shellCommands.command: cd /workspace/node_modules/next && rg -n "registerRequestTracker|requestTracker|RequestTracker" dist/lib --include='*.js' 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== search register call ==="; rg -n "\.register\(" dist/server/base-server.js dist/server/next-server.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/node_modules/next && rg -n "registerRequestTracker|requestTracker" dist --include='*.js' 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== how instrumentation register is called ==="; rg -n "instrumentation\.register|instrumentation\?\.register|\.register\(\{" dist -g '*.js' 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/node_modules/next && rg -n "registerRequestTracker" . -g '*.js' 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== register call sites (instrumentation) ==="; rg -n "register\(" dist/server -g '*.js' 2>/dev/null | rg -i "instrument" | head; echo "=== broad ==="; rg -n "\.register\(" dist -g '*.js' 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace && ls -la; echo "=== next-env.d.ts? ==="; ls next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "none"; echo "=== tsc available? ==="; ls node_modules/.bin/tsc 2>/dev/null && echo "tsc present" || echo "no tsc"
cd /workspace && rm -rf .next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace && (npm run start > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6 ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /missing -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/missing ; sleep 1 ; echo "=== server console ===" ; cat /tmp/next-start.log | grep -E "\] (GET|POST)" ; echo "=== kill ===" ; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo done
